reserveReview.rationale: Midas describes mF-ONE as exposure to Fasanara private-credit and digital-asset strategies. The September 11 aggregate proof-of-reserve view and operational wallet listings do not disclose underlying facility or asset weights. The reserve remains one unresolved strategy envelope without invented borrower, asset or venue allocations. September 15 evidence follow-up retrieved the September 14 onchain-linked SAVE attestation. Its public Fasanara email identifies FASANARA SICAV-RAIF, Sub-Fund 29/F-ONE, Class A-A USD, with Infinite Tokens S.A., Compartment D as noteholder and Midas Software GmbH as beneficiary. This narrows legal and fund identity but does not provide current loan-level composition. The email-derived $59,163,707.13 and $183,228.00 onchain component do not reconcile to the attestation's $65,249,114.22 ops-reported gross reserve; the published calculation uses the ops fallback. No reserve weights or improved coverage are inferred from that remainder.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Midas mF-ONE product disclosure and strategy description
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The September 30 and recovered October 19 Fasanara correspondence identify FASANARA SICAV-RAIF, Sub-Fund 29/F-ONE, Class A-A USD; Infinite Tokens S.A., Compartment D is noteholder and Midas Software GmbH the beneficiary of Class A, Series 2. These identities do not establish mF-ONE holders as direct owners of one fund share, so a 100% standing-feeder fund-share shortcut is not supported. Rechecked 2026-10-20: the exact mFONE API updatedAt=2026-10-20T22:06:24.895Z reports $65.7686300061 million in unmapped general_wallet against $65.977811 million aggregate equity, with only small Midas/USDC and Solana rows. The current October 20 SAVE checkpoint contains October 19 manager note notional, accrued interest and pending-redemption lines, plus rounded protocol-level equity and issuer-reported cross-chain supply. It does not provide complete note terms, fund facility allocations, borrower concentration, maturity/custody mapping, or a reconciled exact note-to-token and pending-liability denominator. Raw protocol totals, note valuations and token liabilities are not interchangeable. Retain the unresolved NAV envelope, 100% known-unknown classification, original reserve-review start, absent compositionAsOf and existing 4-day NAV scoring/7-day transport budgets; the current source retrieval is not a composition refresh or independent whole-book assurance.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The September 30 manager correspondence confirms Infinite Tokens S.A., Compartment D as noteholder and Midas Software GmbH as beneficiary of Class A, Series 2 tied to FASANARA SICAV-RAIF, Sub-Fund 29/F-ONE, Class A-A USD. The October 2 Austrian FMA register names Banque de Patrimoines Privés (Luxembourg) as depositary of Fasanara F-ONE. This establishes a provider at the reference-fund layer only; custody of the intervening note, tokenholder claim and rights, provider shares, asset-level custody and segregation, bankruptcy remoteness and rehypothecation protections for the complete token reserve remain unknown. The succeeding issuer programme prospectus dated July 17, 2026 was recovered, but mF-ONE-specific final terms and inclusion in that programme were not established. No whole-book regulated custody or protective tokenholder rights are inferred.
